content: A brave person carries their sanctuary and home wherever their two feet stand.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: If your inner security requires a specific chair, a familiar room, and your usual comforts, you are an exile whenever you step outside your door. The warrior and sage builds an unshakeable sanctuary within their own ribs: wherever they stand in the storm, they are at home.
practicalInsight: Find your grounded inner sanctuary today, regardless of how unfamiliar or chaotic your external environment feels.
reflectionPrompt: Are you looking for external places to make you feel safe, instead of carrying your home inside your own character?
